subtitles.zh: 我们的父母从未拥有自己的房子，所以我们很向往那个美国梦，想在自己的房子里养大孩子。
subtitles.en: Our parents never own their own homes, so we jumped at the idea of following that American

subtitles.zh: 大多数美国人通过房屋净值来积累财富和构建财务未来。
subtitles.en: dream and raising our kids in our own home.

subtitles.zh: 一个消费者噩梦正变得越来越真实，成千上万的房主深受其害。
subtitles.en: The majority of people in the United States build their wealth and their financial future with the equity of their home.

subtitles.zh: 这些僵尸抵押贷款正在剥夺人们的房屋净值。
subtitles.en: A consumer horror story that's becoming all too real for thousands of homeowners.

subtitles.zh: 他们以为早已还清的贷款，实际上又回来纠缠他们，有些人甚至面临流落街头的风险。
subtitles.en: And these zombie mortgages are robbing people of the equity.

subtitles.zh: 我们知道，这类贷款还有数万甚至数十万笔挂在账上。
subtitles.en: Mortgages that they thought were paid off a long time ago were actually coming back to haunt them, putting some at risk of ending up on the street.

subtitles.zh: 这是一门利润极其丰厚的生意。
subtitles.en: We know it's tens, if not hundreds, of thousands of these loans are still out there on the books.

subtitles.zh: 我们之所以报道这个故事，部分原因是拿到了某家私募股权公司的记录。
subtitles.en: This is a hugely profitable business.

subtitles.zh: 我们称之为“止赎档案”。
subtitles.en: We came to this story in part because we got records on one particular private equity firm.

subtitles.zh: 我们称之为止赎档案。
subtitles.en: We called them the foreclosure files.

subtitles.zh: 我们觉得这是个难得的机会，可以深入了解这个行业，弄清它的运作方式。
subtitles.en: And we decided that we had a unique chance to really get inside this business and figure out how it operated.

subtitles.zh: 我们能看到人们赚了多少钱。
subtitles.en: We can see how much money people are making.
